async def act(page):
    # Click on the Sales link in the menubar to open its dropdown menu
    sales_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Sales")
    await sales_link.click()
    # Wait for the dropdown menu to appear
    await page.get_by_role("menu").wait_for(state="visible")
    # Click on the Orders link within the dropdown menu
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Orders")
    await orders_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return "Navigated to Orders page. Next, need to find and select order #65."
